Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. L00164625
Sheriff’s File # 26000388
PLAINTIFF – Alliance Funding Group, vs:
DEFENDANTS- Christopher Sabin
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 11th day of May, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Howell, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 34.04, Block 170 Tax Map of Township of Howell
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
101 Manfre Court Howell, NJ 07731
Shaun Golden
MONMOUTH COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. L00164625
Sheriff's File #26000388
Alliance Funding Group, Plaintiff vs:
Christopher Sabin, Defendants
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff's Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the Township of Freehold, County of Monmouth, New Jersey, on Monday, the 11th day of May 2026 at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time.
The property to be sold is located in Howell in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 34.04, Block 170 Tax Map of Township of Howell
Commonly known as: 101 Manfre Court Howell, NJ 07731
No. of feet to nearest intersection: Approx. 66 feet from Howell Road
Unpaid real estate taxes and other municipal charges including water and sewer in the approximate amount of $0.
The good faith upset price is $223,934.47
Subject to the following liens:
Mortgage-None
Judgement-Consolidated Electrical, Inc. d/b/a CED Greentech Renewables J-099295-25 in the amount of $38,407.76
Note: The property is owned by Christopher Sabin and Jaqueline Sabin, H/W. Only Christopher Sabin's interest in the property commonly known as 101 Manfre Court, Howell, New Jersey is being sold at this sheriff sale. The successful bidder shall take title subject to Jacqueline Sabin's rights, title, and interest in the property.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000) or certified check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $216,285.20. The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
Dated: Attorney, for the firm Stark & Stark
Attorney Ref.: 01131-2008
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $216,546.20.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: March 6, 2026
Stark & Stark
100 American Boulevard
Hamilton, NJ 08619
